rules: The deadline to register is November 10. Registration is subject to host approval; participation is free with 100 spots.
In person on Sunday, November 15, 2026, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM PST, at EMU Ballroom 244, Erb Memorial Union, University of Oregon, Eugene.
You build a working prototype on Monad during the day, individually or with a team, and demo it to judges in the evening; the top six teams advance to a final pitching round.
Prizes: 1st $2,500, 2nd $1,200, 3rd $600, plus a $300 beginner prize. Amounts are subject to final confirmation.
